fear_data_source.source_description: Baifenwei A-share composite fear-greed series; downloaded full history, then restricted to the registered sample window.

price_data_source.adjustment: official CSI 1000 price index levels; no price adjustment

calculation.signal_clock: Fear-greed value dated t is assumed known after t close.
calculation.screenshot_reproduction_entry: Open of the next row after the date inner-join; this reproduces every displayed screenshot cell at two decimals.
calculation.screenshot_reproduction_exit: Close at N rows after the signal on the inner-joined series; entry session counts as holding day 1.
calculation.strict_calendar_entry: Open of the next official CSI 1000 session after the signal date, even if that session has no fear score.
calculation.strict_calendar_exit: Close of the Nth official CSI 1000 session after the signal date; all intervening official closes enter the drawdown path.
calculation.forward_return: exit close / entry open - 1; arithmetic mean across signal episodes.
calculation.interval_max_drawdown: For each episode, use [entry open, close of entry session, ..., close of exit session] and compute the minimum price / prior running peak - 1; report the arithmetic mean of episode drawdowns.
calculation.transaction_costs: none; descriptive conditional index statistics only
calculation.overlap: Signal windows overlap; sample counts are not independent events.

calendar_alignment_sensitivity.source_of_difference: Fear CSV has no score on 2026-07-27; the strict variant preserves that official price session in subsequent holding paths.
